confirmedCauses: Off-map aim coordinates were independently clamped to map axes, changing the original 3D direction.
Untargeted high sky points were incorrectly classified as orbital engagements, preserving full height while shortening horizontal distance.
First-person trails used a fixed screen origin and interpolation of already projected endpoints, so old bullets reattached to the current view and perspective motion was wrong.
Valid targets at maximum centre-based range were shortened a second time from an offset model muzzle while retaining their damage target.
fixes: RMB exclusively controls temporary optics; LMB exclusively controls the trigger. V observation and zoom remain available.
Freeze validated model muzzle origin at input edge; clamp untargeted rays by a single 3D scale. Orbital projection requires a validated real target.
Validated target engagements preserve actual mesh impact coordinates under existing centre-based range rules; spread misses retain geometry without target damage.
Interpolate world-space shot progress, clip all six camera planes before projecting, distinguish continuous beams and bounded world-length tracers with a soft edge.
